# 2002 GMC Yukon XL 2500 SLE — For Sale

> A single-page listing for a 2002 GMC Yukon XL 2500 SLE, 8.1L V8, 4×4, offered for
> sale by the private owner. Located in Santa Fe, New Mexico. Asking $9,000 or best offer.

## Vehicle
- Year / Make / Model: 2002 GMC Yukon XL 2500 SLE, 4WD
- VIN: 3GKGK26G82G182056
- Engine: 8.1L (496ci) Vortec V8 (factory 340 hp / 455 lb-ft)
- Transmission: heavy-duty 4-speed automatic with overdrive and tow/haul; Autotrac push-button 4WD
- Drivetrain: 3.73 axle with locking rear differential; Autoride load-leveling suspension; 8,600-lb GVWR
- Towing: ~10,100 lbs (upgradable to ~12,000 lbs with a 4.10 axle ratio); Prodigy trailer-brake controller installed
- Color: Storm Gray Metallic over Graphite/Pewter cloth
- Mileage: 195,913
- History: clean, two-owner Carfax — no accidents, no odometer issues; lifelong rust-free New Mexico vehicle
- Seating: 5 (two rows; factory third-row bench not included)
- Known issues: auxiliary-tank fuel pump broken (usable fuel ~28.5 of 38.5 gal); fuel gauge non-functional since the aux pump failed

## Price & Contact
